newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's sees Q4 diluted shr at $1.12.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's sees Q4 diluted shr at $1.12.

text.p: Department store retailer Proffitt's Inc said it expected fully diluted earnings per share of about $1.12 and $2.15 for the February 1 fourth quarter and year respectively following its merger with G.R. Herberger's Inc.
The company said it was comfortable with fully diluted earnings per share of about $1.20 and $2.24 for the two periods respectively before including the merger in its results.
It said it was also "comfortable" with estimated revenues between $2.375 billion and $2.425 billion for 1997.
"Based on this revenue range, we believe a reasonable fully diluted earnings per share target would be $2.80 for 1997," it said, adding that it raised the target from $2.75 due to the merger.

Proffitt's, which is to release its results on March 20, agreed to merge with Herberger's last November in a deal worth $169 million. Herberger's will operate as a separate store division of Proffitt's, with its divisional headquarters in St. Cloud, Minnesota.
It said it would incur "certain non-recurring transaction and restructuring charges" totalling about $6 million related to the merger, mostly in the fourth quarter.

Restructuring costs and other non-recurring charges related to the merger will total $25 million to $28 million after tax, it said. About $18 million to $19 million of the total will be incurred in 1996 and about $7 million to $9 million in 1997, it added.
Proffitt's said it would also take a non-recurring charge of about $2.5 million in the fourth quarter of 1996 following the closing of seven Virginia stores, which are being sold.
